hypotheses.M0_pair_mobius_reconstructs_response: Across every triple, the second-order Mobius response has median cosine >=0.95 and 10th-percentile cosine >=0.80 to the exact triple response on both corpora.
hypotheses.M1_pair_mobius_selects_equivalent_progra: Programs selected from the reconstructed response have median exact finite-effect fidelity >=0.95 and 10th-percentile fidelity >=0.80 to programs selected from the exact triple response on both corpora.
hypotheses.M2_pair_mobius_recovers_support: Median selected-mode support recall is at least 0.75 on both corpora.
hypotheses.M3_true_third_order_propagation_is_requi: Finite-effect fidelity has median below 0.80 or 10th percentile below 0.50 on either corpus.
